title: Evaluation of the interactions of hydrazide derivatives with acetic acid and molecular modeling analysis of N-acetylated hydrazides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13618-13627
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01286D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hamid Beyzaei, Sakineh Sheikh, Fereshteh Shiri, Reza Aryan
Acetic acid as a reagent, solvent and catalyst was reacted with hydrazide derivatives under reflux heating. C- and N-acetylation, hydrolysis and rearrangement were observed in these interactions. The biological activities and pharmacological potentials of the synthesized products were assessed.
